execution_model.name: finite-stage-potentially-unbounded
execution_model.stages: C_0 subseteq C_1 subseteq C_2 subseteq ...
execution_model.omega_object: C_omega := formal direct-limit object of the finite stages

resource_semantics.interpretation: For every admitted finite requirement, the model may search for a sufficiently large finite stage; this does not instantiate infinite CPU, RAM, storage, time, energy, or hardware.

algebra.stage_state: finite-support valuation vector v in N^(N)
algebra.finite_stage_log_coordinate: Lambda(v)=sum_i v_i log(p_i) over finite support
algebra.omega_completion: symbolic completion/direct-limit object; no convergent infinite prime product is required

computability_boundary.statement: Potentially unbounded finite-stage execution does not by itself decide every undecidable problem.
